official_result.meaning: Passes the predeclared tolerance; does not establish causal improvement or reliable absolute quality.

method.prompt_validation: Reconstructed from frozen content, templates and dates; compared with complete legacy user prompts, stored legacy system prefixes, core redacted/truncated traces and full character counts. Full core HTTP bodies were not captured.
method.scope: Observed local paired run, not a statistical equivalence proof or legal validation of the goldset.
method.finalization: All 196 items committed before process loss. Bounded reconstruction exactly matches the already finalized legacy aggregates; only the unfinished core run status/aggregates were finalized. Item rows and judgments unchanged; termination cause unknown.

observations.q203_limit: Same retrieved chunk set, two positions exchanged (95 and 98, one-based); same selector prompt and both answers fail. Ranking difference cause not isolated.
observations.global_recall_limit: Includes upstream references even when the selector later removes the useful material.

discordant_cases.finding: The only changed operative query; legacy selector parsing fails and keeps the first five candidates. Inputs already differ. The core answer and its PASS also warrant review for the distinction between continuation and mandatory renewal.

Same selector input. Legacy parsing failure keeps five candidates including the ministry guide; core chooses three and drops the guide. Served-context recall falls from 1.0 to 0.6; the core answer omits ministry-specific remuneration details.

Core adds a procedural section and answers the main point more directly. Its judge nevertheless credits a named allowance absent from the candidate, and tolerates a condition criticized in the legacy judgment. The gain is not a clean engine effect.

Identical generation messages. Both answers omit the same renewal notice period. Legacy completeness is 2/3 in all votes; core receives 0.8, 1.0 and 0.6, and wins by 2/3. One core vote infers the missing period from an unrelated renewal-duration passage.

Both candidates omit the same illegal-motive qualification. All legacy votes credit the whole gold passage from citations covering only discretionary renewal; all core votes penalize the absent qualification. Different contexts do not explain crediting an absent candidate statement.

Identical generation messages. Both candidates say the source does not address one requested entitlement. Legacy is failed for abstention; core is credited as explicitly denying that entitlement. Absence of source coverage is conflated with absence of a right.
Identical selector input. Legacy keeps candidates 0 and 2; core keeps 9. Served-context recall falls from 1.0 to 0.0 and core abstains. The useful material was retrieved before being filtered out.
Identical selector input. Core replaces the ministry guide at index 2 with Service-Public at index 3. The candidate omits the internal-grid requirement found in the legacy answer.

The core selector response has an unclosed JSON fence; both parsers fail on it and apply the same first-five fallback. Both answers omit two gold requirements, yet completeness penalties differ sharply. A core vote also labels a timing qualification missing despite its presence in its own cited passage.

Core drops a complementary section at index 3. Both answers retain the main correspondence table, but core emphasizes an upstream document and receives a contradiction verdict. This case needs criterion-level review rather than attributing the whole loss to retrieval.

limits: Shared prompts and configured parameters locate output variability, but do not identify provider-internal sampling or prove all transport options identical.
The same stored response is parsed identically by both implementations; the complete engines were not replayed on all 98 frozen provider responses.
Passage-ID validation guarantees quotation provenance only. Required point selection, entailment and completeness scoring remain model judgments.
Classification is a manual diagnostic of the ten discordant cases, with mixed causes allowed; official scores remain unchanged.
One follow-up pair changes both SQL behavior and generated responses; score improvement cannot be attributed solely to the SQL fix.
The final artifact exporter remains a robustness follow-up; no process-exit cause is asserted.
prioritized_follow_up: Freeze question-specific atomic criteria and weights once for both candidates, then compute completeness from that common checklist; review the four clearest judge inconsistencies (177,186,189,827).
Replay the same recorded selector/generator outcomes through both engines to isolate implementation differences; seven existing M0b scenarios are not a replay of this full goldset.
Handle malformed selector envelopes consistently in both adapters and replay the eight observed failures offline before a new live measurement.
Track served-context coverage as a separate diagnostic and retain the ministry-specific source where it contributes a required point; do not retroactively change the gate.
